text:
Maya K.: Quick heads-up — I'm scheduling a staggered engine swap tonight with a fallback bridge for the quantized kernels. Quiet window 00:30-01:30 UTC.

deploybot: deploy scheduled by Maya K. ➜ engine-release/2024-04-20-kv2 (canary -> staged -> ramp) :rocket:

Jasper: Nice. Which clusters are first wave?

Maya K.: Wave 1 = us-west1 primary, us-east1 secondary. Wave 2 = eu-west1. Bridge will be enabled in wave 1 so we can fallback to pre-quant runtime per-node if latencies spike.

Ryan O.: Put me on pager for first 45m. I'll watch tail latency and OOM logs.

Sarah L.: I'll draft a short release-note blurb and a rollback checklist. Do we have a probe set for matmul precision regression?

Maya K.: Yes — small eval set in s3://redwood-prod/telemetry/quant-matmul/probeset-quick.json. We'll run it as smoke in canary.

Jasper: Telemetry checklist:
- pre/post perf snapshot (p50/p95/p99)
- kv cache hitrate
- error 429/5xx by route
- matmul numerical diffs summary

Maya K.: Agreed. Also add GPU thermal deltas; last time we saw a thermal-induced perf skew during long sequences.

deploybot: canary rollout started (us-west1: 2% of traffic). Monitoring hooks active.

eng-oncall-bot: Alert policy ‘engine-canary-latency’ armed. Thresholds: p95 > 1200ms or error rate +0.5% -> notify #eng-oncall.

Ryan O.: Seeing a slight bump in p95 in canary — +180ms, p50 stable. Not yet alarming but keeping eyes.

Maya K.: Good catch. Is matmul diff small? Jasper, can you pull the numeric diff?

Jasper: quick check — mean relative diff = 0.0009 on probe set, max diff 0.003. Within tolerances for v2 quant.

Ryan O.: p95 still creeping. Kicking a small rollback exercise on one node with bridge fallback to confirm seamlessness.

deploybot: initiating per-node fallback on instance us-west1-a-03. Bridge engaged, traffic switched to pre-quant engine. Instance nominal.

Ryan O.: p95 drops back to baseline after fallback. Looks like one hot node had cache thrash + thermal spike.

Maya K.: Good — that's exactly why we have the bridge. We'll pause ramp until we validate broader stability across more nodes.

Sarah L.: Release-note draft: 
"Kernel ABI bump + quantized matmul v2. Staged rollout with fallback bridge enabled; rollback plan includes per-node bridge fallback and full-pin strategy. Watch p95 and matmul diffs."

Maya K.: Add note about telemetry buckets and the s3 probe path. Also include contact for oncall and release owner.

Jasper: Ops action: create a pin if we need to abort full rollout — `deploybot pin engine-release/2024-04-20-kv2 --reason "rollout abort"`

Maya K.: We'll hold ramp. Tentative next step: expand to 10% tomorrow 02:00 UTC after a bake period and a short smoke in eu-west1. If anything regresses we'll pin and open an incident.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder — incident template available at /ops/incidents/engine-rollout-template.md.

Ryan O.: I'm retaining extra logs and kv-cache traces from the canary nodes; will share a quick summary in 30m.

Maya K.: Thanks team. Leaving deploybot paused in staging. If all clear, I'll resume ramp and post final notes here. :thumbsup:
